units.source_text: 父亲去后，紫儿不堪寂寞，时常哭泣。

en.t: After her father went away, Zi'er could not bear the loneliness and often wept.

units.source_text: 她还不懂得考虑自己身世问题。

en.t: She was still too young to think about the question of her own circumstances.

units.source_text: 她只是记念外婆，年来时刻不离左右，今后永远不能再见，想起了好不伤心！

en.t: She only missed her grandmother, who had been constantly by her side for years, and when she thought that she would never see her again, she was overcome with grief.

units.source_text: 虽然还是个孩子，也不免愁绪满怀，日常的游戏都废止了。

en.t: Although she was still a child, her heart was filled with sorrow, and she gave up all her usual games.

units.source_text: 白昼还可散心，暂时忘忧；到了晚上，便吞声饮泣。

en.t: During the day she could still distract herself and forget her sorrow for a while; but when night came, she stifled her voice and wept.

units.source_text: 少纳言乳母安慰乏术，只得陪着她哭，并且悲叹：“照此情况，日子如何过得下去！”

en.t: Her nurse Shonagon had no way to comfort her, and could only cry beside her, lamenting, "If things go on like this, how can we possibly get through the days?"
